subtopic: Auction Rate Securities Buybacks and Redemptions
source_evidence: These settlements included agreements to buy back ARS from certain investors.  In addition, many issuers of ARS have redeemed their ARS and converted to other types of securities.
answer: ARS buybacks and redemptions were two ways some investors’ ARS were addressed after the market collapse. Settlements included agreements to buy back ARS from certain investors. Separately, many issuers redeemed their ARS and converted them to other types of securities. The source describes these actions as applying to certain investors or many issuers—not as a buyback or redemption for every ARS holder.
